searches.note: Twenty four searches of twenty eight, four unspent. Most searches blocked the author's own sources so the second source would be independent; two were held to the house's own domains (alcohuaz.cl and vdalcohuaz.cl, undurraga.cl). No WebFetch was tried.

method: Each record was read with one instruction, refute it: founding, people and dates, grapes, sites, making, label words, every beat of the story, the cards and the questions; then the house rules.
Where a search contradicted the record it was set right with its source; where a detail stood in one source or none it was cut or hedged as the house's account.

tested: 1998, the Trentino cousin winemaker, the 1951 arrival and Dimaro: Spanish Wikipedia, Turismo Vicuña, wine-pages, Expo Vino Costa Rica. Sound; the arrival is in the Elqui.
The pisco planting of the early 1970s and El Tambo: Turismo Vicuña gives 1974, another 1975; El Tambo is not found for the founder, only for Mayu's vineyards. Changed.
Mayu as the family's second label: Wine Anorak, wine-pages, Elqui Global, Polaner, Mayu's history page. Refuted: a separate winery of 2005.
The making: the 22 to 24 degrees is on the Gran Reserva 2021 sheet; eight months in barrique on the Reserva by Great Western Wine and Enotria. Changed.
Titón nearer the coast: South America Wine Guide and a critic's note give 18 km from the sea at about 320 to 350 metres; one listing places a Fundo Titón near Vicuña. Kept as relative.
The Carmenère appassimento in the trap: Decanter 2015 Reserva Carmenère and LCBO on the Gran Reserva. Sound.

questions: All ten questions read: one key each, distractors of one kind; Undurraga's wine question and Falernia's story question reworded to the corrected facts.
codexTension: The region's producers line for Viñedos de Alcohuaz says above 2,000 metres; Tococo is at about 1,788 metres, though the estate runs to 2,206. Reported, not edited.
The region's producers line for Falernia says it proved Elqui could make fine Syrah, a ranking the record does not repeat.
